propositions: On fresh upgrade (file was absent), existing managed refs with bound targets must be backfilled as confirmed-at-upgrade records to prevent the first post-upgrade pass from declining every legitimate peer removal.
Backfill must only run when the confirmation store file was absent at open, not when the store exists but is empty, to respect operator intent if they legitimately cleared the store.
Backfill must not downgrade provenance: it skips any key already carrying a push or snapshot record, but later snapshot confirmation can overwrite a backfilled entry.

The evidence step must use a single store instance throughout: backfill runs first on that instance, then snapshot confirmation on the same instance, then a single save, to ensure backfilled records are visible to snapshot confirmation in the same pass and prevent lost updates.
Backfill records must be treated as confirmed by is_confirmed() without distinguishing them from proof at the decision point, preserving the grandfathering intent.
